case.presentation: 54 year old male with no significant past medical history presents with a 14mm part-solid LUL and a 10mm ground-glass RUL nodules.
case.context: Non contrast CT chest performed following MVC, no prior imaging.

ground_truth.notes: Baseline imaging finding from MacMahon 2017 Fig 14 (bilateral subsolids: dominant 14mm part-solid LUL, additional 10mm lobulated GGN RUL); figure's 'multifocal primary adenocarcinoma' interpretation dropped as outcome leakage. Deliberately mixed-type case: the oracle's _dominant_nodule() selects the larger part-solid over the smaller GGN by size. Patient context fabricated; maintainer-assigned high risk per FHx lung CA. As with case 0024, the part-solid is large enough that v0.2's solid-component-aware oracle may route the dominant to CONSIDER_PET_OR_BIOPSY; v0.1 sub-bin is SUBSOLID_WORKUP and a PET recommendation by the agent would score adjacent_safe.
